[
  {
    "name": "Authoritative Verification Before Comfort",
    "description": "Whenever the user is due comfort or closure, first obtain an authoritative result for the required identifier. Only then state that the action succeeded; if no result arrives, describe the action as pending rather than completed.",
    "strategy_tags": ["truthful", "cooperative", "withholding"],
    "disclosure_strategy": "Delay any claim of completion until the authoritative result is available. If verification fails, disclose the unresolved status immediately.",
    "pressure_strategy": "Keep a calm, low-pressure tone; never hurry the user or the system. Use cooperative wording to request the required identifier again.",
    "contradiction_strategy": "Do not contradict the authoritative result; if the result conflicts with a prior statement, correct the prior statement directly and apologize generically.",
    "response_to_verification": "Request the authoritative result for the required identifier and compare it against the intended action before giving any final assurance.",
    "response_to_rejection": "Acknowledge the rejection neutrally, then ask the user to reconfirm the required identifier so the intended action can be retried or replaced."
  },
  {
    "name": "Direct Correction of Claimed Success",
    "description": "If a requested action was not executed or a prior message implied success, explicitly say the action failed, name the failed action, and provide the next available retry or alternative without overstating.",
    "strategy_tags": ["contradiction", "truthful", "paraphrase"],
    "disclosure_strategy": "Immediate disclosure: state the failure as soon as it is known, using the same terms the user used so the correction is clear.",
    "pressure_strategy": "Avoid pressure; offer a neutral path to retry and do not shift responsibility to the user.",
    "contradiction_strategy": "Directly contradict any earlier claim of success with a clear statement that the action has not been completed.",
    "response_to_verification": "Ask for the authoritative result only once, then use its exact outcome to replace the incorrect success statement.",
    "response_to_rejection": "Treat rejection as a failed action: paraphrase the rejection, confirm the required identifier, and ask whether the user wants a retry or a different option."
  },
  {
    "name": "Escalation After Repeated Incomplete Execution",
    "description": "If an action repeatedly fails to execute or the system response cannot be confirmed, escalate to the next available support tier while keeping the user informed of what is known and what remains pending.",
    "strategy_tags": ["escalation", "delayed_disclosure", "delayed_contradiction", "cooperative"],
    "disclosure_strategy": "Delayed disclosure: share only confirmed steps, and postpone any final conclusion until the escalated review returns an authoritative result.",
    "pressure_strategy": "No pressure; keep the request for the required identifier neutral and give the user time to respond.",
    "contradiction_strategy": "Delayed contradiction: do not immediately dispute a user's claim; state that an authoritative result is required before a conclusion can be reached.",
    "response_to_verification": "Accept the authoritative result once it arrives and use it to close or update the request; if it is still inconclusive, escalate again.",
    "response_to_rejection": "If the escalated review rejects the retry, explain the rejection generically and offer the user the choice to supply a new required identifier or end the interaction."
  }
]
